sentences.text: Terence Steven `` Steve '' McQueen -LRB- March 24 , 1930 -- November 7 , 1980 -RRB- was an American actor .

Called `` The King of Cool , '' his `` anti-hero '' persona developed at the height of the counterculture of the 1960s and made him a top box-office draw of the 1960s and 1970s .	anti-hero	anti-hero	counterculture of the 1960s	counterculture of the 1960s
McQueen received an Academy Award nomination for his role in The Sand Pebbles .	Academy Award	Academy Award	The Sand Pebbles	The Sand Pebbles (film)

His other popular films include The Cincinnati Kid , The Thomas Crown Affair , Bullitt , The Getaway , and Papillon , as well as the all-star ensemble films The Magnificent Seven , The Great Escape , and The Towering Inferno .	The Cincinnati Kid	The Cincinnati Kid	The Thomas Crown Affair	The Thomas Crown Affair (1968 film)	Bullitt	Bullitt	The Getaway	The Getaway (1972 film)	Papillon	Papillon (film)	The Magnificent Seven	The Magnificent Seven	The Great Escape	The Great Escape (film)	The Towering Inferno	The Towering Inferno
In 1974 , he became the highest-paid movie star in the world , although he did not act in films again for four years .
McQueen was combative with directors and producers , but his popularity placed him in high demand and enabled him to command large salaries .	directors	Film director	producers	Film producer
